**Week 1 mindset:** "Blitz mode." Send all tier-1 simultaneously. Expect NO responses for 2+ weeks. This is normal.
**Week 2-3 mindset:** "Fill the funnel." Tier-2 submissions while waiting on tier-1. Keep momentum.
**Week 3+ mindset:** "Volume play." Tier-3 saturation. Some fast turnarounds (7-14 days). Others slow (60-120 days).
**If tier-1 accepts:** Congratulations. Notify other tier-1 outlets you're withdrawn. Some tier-2/3 may still take it (non-exclusive). Decide based on your rights strategy.
**If tier-1 rejects:** Don't take it personally. Double-check anonymization + edit based on feedback (if given). Tier-2 is your safety net.
**If multiple accept:** Pick the top-tier publication for first publication. Then decide: republish everywhere (saturation) or exclusive rights (if editor demands).
